task: Sort all users by total number of channel messages they wrote and to each user write the message: Congrats on being the k-th most active user! (where k is replaced with the user's rank). Resolve ties alphabetically.

clauses.instruction: to each user write the message: Congrats on being the k-th most active user! (where k is replaced with the user's rank)

body.literal: Congrats on being the k-th most active user!
